tool.name: Inline electron holography
tool.description: focal-series reconstruction (TIE, FRWR3, ...), FRWR alignment, DIH strain, NXem export
tool.command: mkdir -p ./data ./output && #for $f in $infiles: ln -sf '$f' './data/${f.element_identifier}' && #end for export INLINEHOLO_DATA="\$(pwd)/data" && export MPLBACKEND=Agg SOLARA_TELEMETRY_MIXPANEL_ENABLE=False && solara run /opt/inlineholo/webapp/solara_app.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8765 --production --no-open

param.name: infiles
param.label: Focal series (NXem/NeXus, DM3/DM4, TIFF, .img frames, ...)
param.help: Shown in tab 1 under 'file in data folder' and in the file browser; NOMAD uploads can also be read directly in tab 1.

tool.help: Interactive web application for inline electron holography (focal-series exit-wave reconstruction). Select the focal series from your history, open the tool, process the data in the browser and stop the tool to get the NXem (.nxs) result files back into the history.
